thumbnail.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: illustrative property background for an established Cash As-Is blog thumbnail, no graphic design. Wide landscape photograph of a modest older single-story Houston-area tan brick house on the RIGHT half, visible entry and mature trees, a few ordinary signs of wear, quiet grass frontage, bright soft afternoon daylight, authentic realistic building proportions. Left 55 percent dark leafy tree shade and uncluttered lawn negative space for an existing deterministic typography overlay. No people, text, numbers, street addresses, signs, logos or watermarks. Not a real listing, no disaster. Composition should crop naturally to1200x630. Do not add branding, banner, gradients or lettering.
